title: US Market Indexes Close Higher, Nasdaq Retreats

Bookmark of this page has been deleted. US Market Indexes Close Higher, Nasdaq Retreats Dow Jones closes at 25,998.92 for a gain of 0.11% September 12, 2018 | About: LBRT +0% TLRY +0% AAPL +0% BA +0% GE +0% CAT +0% PG +0% MRK +0%
The Dow Jones Industrial Average closed at 25,998.92 on Wednesday for a gain of 27.86 points or 0.11%. The S&P 500 closed at 2,888.92 for a gain of 1.03 points or 0.04%. The Nasdaq Composite closed at 7,954.23 for a loss of -18.24 points or -0.23%. The VIX Volatility Index was lower at 13.14 for a loss of -0.08 points or -0.61%.
Wednesday’s market movers
U.S. market indexes closed with mostly positive gains on Wednesday. Technology stocks and the Nasdaq were slightly lower. The Fed’s Beige Book showed a slightly improved status on economic growth. Meanwhile, the U.S. and Canada continued their trade negotiations and the Trump administration announced possible trade negotiation proposals with China, giving the country a chance to discuss factors involving trade before implementing another round of tariffs.
Across the broad market, the consumer staples, energy and industrial sectors led gains. Top contributors for the day included Liberty Oilfield Services ( NYSE:LBRT ) and Tilray ( NASDAQ:TLRY ). Apple ( NASDAQ:AAPL ) was a top detractor for the day, reporting a loss of -1.24%.
